newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian markets in disarray as rupiah plunges.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian markets in disarray as rupiah plunges.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah plunged to a historic low against the dollar on Monday as overseas investors mounted a fierce speculative attack on the currency, dealers said.
The rupiah sank from its 2,510/20 open to 2,640 against the dollar by mid-morning.
The stock market index fell 1.58 percent on the rupiah volatility, reaching 712.45 points by mid-morning.
Dealers said the central Bank Indonesia was inquiring about currency rates but had made no move to intervene. The bank fixed its intervention band at 2,377/2,681 on Friday.
